description: This file defines types related to observability webhook configurations, events, batch processing, forwarder status, dead letter handling, and API request/response structures within an observability system.

classes.name: ObservabilityWebhookConfig
classes.description: Represents the global configuration for observability webhook, including URL, secret, headers, enabled flag, and timestamps.

classes.name: ObservabilityWebhookConfigRequest
classes.description: API request structure for creating or updating webhook configuration, including optional secret, headers, and enabled flag.

classes.name: ObservabilityWebhookConfigResponse
classes.description: API response structure indicating whether the configuration is set up and returning the config details.

classes.name: ObservabilityEvent
classes.description: Encapsulates a normalized event sent to the webhook, including event type, source, timestamp, and payload data.

classes.name: ObservabilityEventBatch
classes.description: Groups multiple events for batch delivery, containing batch ID, event count, list of events, and timestamp.

classes.name: ObservabilityForwarderStatus
classes.description: Provides current state of the forwarder, including webhook URL, queue depth, event counts, last forwarded time, and errors.

classes.name: ObservabilityDeadLetterEntry
classes.description: Represents an event that failed to deliver, with details about the event, error message, retry count, and timestamps.

classes.name: ObservabilityDeadLetterListResponse
classes.description: Response structure for listing dead letter queue entries, including entries and total count.

classes.name: ObservabilityRedriveResponse
classes.description: Response for the redrive operation, indicating success and processing results.
